description: List owner-scoped image assets in the media library with optional search query q. Returns image IDs, CDN URLs, dimensions, and rights status for slot assignment. Call to browse media assets or discover imageId before slot binding. Alternatives: Use get_image to fetch full metadata for a specific imageId. Read-only query scoped to workspace owner.

q.description: Search term matching image name or provenance source.

name: list_images
title: List images
